description: No key needed. Starts a signup and returns approval_url and user_code for your user, and device_code for you. Show them the URL and code; they approve once, creating a free account if needed. data_wanted and use_case are required: infer them from the project and conversation you are working in, and ask your user one short question only if you cannot. found_us is optional; never guess it. Then call finish_signup.

agent.description: Your agent or client name, shown to your user.

data_wanted.description: Required. What data they want, inferred from the project.

ref.description: Optional. The ref value (ai-...) from the page that sent you here, if any.

use_case.description: Required. What they are building, inferred from the project.

name: start_signup
title: Start getting an API key
